title: Vegan Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy vegan stir fry made with tender vegetables and a tangy sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the carrots and broccoli, stir frying for 3-4 minutes.
Add the mushrooms, stir frying for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the stir fry sauce and stir to combine.
Continue stir frying for another 2-3 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
